home.title: Pro Home
home.bookServiceDetail: Use EazyServ as a customer. Your Pro app is one tap away on Profile.
home.toastOnline: You're online — your team can give you jobs
home.toggleFailed: Couldn't update your status. Please try again.

onlineSwitch.verified: Your team can only give you jobs while this is on.
onlineSwitch.unverifiedOnline: Your team can't give you jobs until your identity is verified.
onlineSwitch.unverifiedOffline: You can go online once your identity is verified.

kycStatus.submittedDetail: This usually takes a day. You can take jobs once it's approved.
kycStatus.rejectedTitle: Your identity check didn't go through
kycStatus.rejectedWithReason: Reason: {{reason}}. Please submit your documents again.
kycStatus.pendingTitle: Verify your identity to get jobs
kycStatus.pendingDetail: Your team can't give you a job until your Aadhaar is verified.

location.deniedDetail: Allow location for EazyServ in your phone’s settings so your team can see where you are.
location.offDetail: Turn it on so your team can see where you are while you’re online.

jobs.title: Your jobs
jobs.activeHint: Jobs your team has given you that aren’t finished yet.
jobs.pastHint: Jobs you’ve finished, and ones that were cancelled.
jobs.emptyActiveSubtitle: Stay online from Home. When your team gives you a job, it shows up here.
jobs.emptyPastSubtitle: Jobs you finish will be listed here.
jobs.showingRecent: Showing your {{count}} most recent jobs of {{total}}.

jobDetail.goneTitle: This job is no longer yours
jobDetail.goneDetail: There’s nothing left to do here.
jobDetail.expired: This job expired. There’s nothing left to do here.

kyc.title: Verify your identity
kyc.intro: Take a live photo of your Aadhaar (front and back) and a selfie. Your team can give you jobs once these are approved.
kyc.sent: Documents sent. We’ll check them, usually within a day.
kyc.sendFailed: Couldn’t send your documents. Please try again.

decline.title: Decline this job?
decline.body: Your team will be asked to give it to someone else. You can’t take it back once declined.
decline.repick: Job declined. Your team will pick someone else.
decline.reopened: Job declined. We’ll find the customer someone else.
decline.enRoute: You’re already on your way, so you can’t decline now. Talk to your team.
decline.gone: This job is no longer yours.
decline.failed: Couldn’t decline the job. Please try again.

pushToast.assignedBody: Your team gave you a job.
pushToast.jobCancelledBody: This job has been cancelled. Please don't travel to it.
pushToast.unassignedBody: This job is no longer assigned to you. Please don't travel to it.
